P_0x001BDC.en: Captain of Langran's Ruzak border guard, lieutenant rank. Courteous, well-mannered. Senior alumnus of Masaki's mentor Zeolute's academy.

P_0x001CA9.en: Desert-raised surface dweller, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. Finds his place only through battle, yet seeks peace his own way. Skilled at gathering intel; sometimes acts alone for it.

P_0x001EDA.en: A Holy Langran soldier. Once thought mediocre, believed to owe his rank to lineage, he proved himself amid war's chaos by minimizing his own losses. Bold, yet a solid tactician.

P_0x002B23.en: A Shtedonias soldier, a skilled pilot but prone to clashing with superiors, which stalls his promotion.

P_0x002C58.en: A Kirkus soldier, a magic officer skilled in sorcery. Fastidious and obsessed with justice.

P_0x002CE3.en: A demon priest of the destruction god Sarva Volkruss. Polite but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prepare Volkruss's revival.

P_0x005D86.en: Chief of <Project TD>'s system dev team, keeping it running with backing from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Caring, personable, yet capable of cold, rational judgment.

P_0x0066BD.en: Advisor to the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. A Jigen-ryu sword master who helped develop Grungust's blade and sword data. Teacher to Sanger and Brit. Strict on swordplay, easygoing else.

P_0x008924.en: Tests Medius Locus, a TE Absorber from the Zentle Project. Ex-captain of "Craywolves," <Earth Fed>'s 3rd Special Ops <PT> Unit. Strict, dutiful.

P_0x008A4B.en: AI researcher who developed "AI-0," a high-performance combat AI. Former instructor at the Federation Army officers' academy; Aqua Centrum was her student.

P_0x009095.en: One of Ruina's pseudo-life forms, the Meliorexe. To revive the "King of Ruin" she needs waves of negative emotion, so she pilots the Fortis Ala in repeated destruction and slaughter. Calm, collected, merciless to those who defy her.

P_0x009F48.en: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.

P_0x00A244.en: Commander of "GS," the Gaia Sabers, under the <Earth Fed Gov't> President. Near the <Inspector Incident> she approached Graien Grusman via Nibhal Mubhal, earning a special post. Cold, ambitious.

P_0x00A3C2.en: A Gaia Sabers scientist. Studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also developed the <Geim System>.

P_0x00ACD1.en: Key member of <SRX Project>; superb engineer, co-creator of <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist, gets along with his opposite Robert. Once wed to Marion.

P_0x00CC05.en: President of <Earth Fed Gov't>. A hawk on resisting aliens; nicknamed "the Wizard" for looks and backroom skill.

P_0x00CCE5.en: President of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, daughter of ex-president Renji Isurugi (died in <L5 Campaign>). Gentle, shrewd beauty; puts profit first, picky about neither methods nor partners.

P_0x00CFED.en: Brilliant scientist, ex-<EOTI Organization>, now makes weapons for Zentl Project. Also designed the Granzon.

P_0x00EEB5.en: Marshal of the <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist, sees the big picture, accepts good and ill. Dry, but loves sake and grandkids.

P_0x00EF62.en: Chairman of <Earth Fed Army> Joint Chiefs, ranked General. Gaspard's right-hand man. Cautious, bureaucratic - clashed with pragmatic Norman Sley, founder of Earth Sphere Defense Committee.

P_0x00F25B.en: Upper house member, <Earth Fed Gov't> parliament. Aqua Centrum's father. Serious, doting, worries constantly about Aqua, who ran off to join the military.

U_0x0171A6.en: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> built for hit-and-run. Standard armament trails other <Elemental>s, so weak pilots can't unlock its full power. Output is stable and its spirit accepts almost any pilot - hence the mass-produced Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.

U_0x0173AA.en: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike normal <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein series data, giving a distinct look. No spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a high-<Prana> pilot rival a <Masoukishin>. Tradeoff: short operating time.

U_0x001802.en: Unit 1 of the RW Series <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN." Originally a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, miniaturized for a purpose and given <Personal Trooper> transformation to fight solo. Its <Tronium> Engine beats R-2's, with output/firepower above other R Series units, though unstable. Effectively the 4th R Series unit but never named "R-4," secretly developed at <Mao Industries> on the Moon under codename "ARGAN." With plus parts like the back-mounted High Twin Launcher it becomes R-GUN Powered. After the <L5 Campaign>, an improved <T-LINK System> enabled T-LINK Twin Contact with R-3.

U_0x0045EE.en: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Machinery Children. A Mass-Prod Huckebein Mk-II remade with <Machine Cell> for new form and higher specs. Mounts the <Geim System> and remote weapons; its <Machine Cell> frame self-repairs.

U_0x0054BB.en: Third unit (SRG-03-3) of the newest Grungusts, from the <Tesla Leicht Institute> under the <SRX Project>, unfrozen after the <L5 Campaign>. Based on the Grungust (Type-1) and specialized for melee, with the series' highest output and attack power. Splits into the G-Raptor fighter (upper body) and G-Bison tank (lower body), one pilot each. After the <Inspector Incident>, it gained the <T-LINK System>, a <Tesla Drive>, and the Type-3 Shishioh Blade (<S.Unit>-size).

U_0x00827E.en:
The R-Blade is <Mao Industries>' simplified mass-production prototype <Personal Trooper> based on R-1. It omits R-1's flight transform and <T-LINK System> (telekinesis sensor-amp) but performs well.
The R-Blade Custom refits prototype 3 for close combat, adding a <Tesla Drive>, Split Beam Cannon, and the Wild Wurger's jacket armor.

U_0x00A1F1.en: Combined form of the Altairlion and Vegalion, newest <Project TD> Series 77 units. Its mobility and agility top every <Armored Module>, with immense firepower.

U_0x00B141.en: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion prototype, customized for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX.

U_0x00B4DF.en: Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion' = 'Refined Lion.' Human-type arms wield varied weapons like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger, easier to handle, maintain, and produce than the Lion.

U_0x00D259.en: A large space battleship used by <Earth Fed Army> and others, often a fleet flagship, with strong search and spacecraft control. Made of a battle carrier bearing space fighters and <Armored Module>s, plus five beam-cannon ships. These can act alone and evacuate crew to be used as missiles themselves.

U_0x00E871.en: Aerial combat carrier used by the <Earth Fed Army> and others. Fighters and <Armored Module>s launch and land in flight; its air defenses and armament make it a flying fortress.
